name: legal_tags_author_labelled
labelled_by: the implementing AI agent, after reading each chunk. NOT a human and NOT a legal professional.
note: 30 chunk and tag pairs for the agreement check of the legal check. Tags use the meaning in prompts/legal_tag_chunk.md: marketplace, seller_on_marketplace, direct_seller (includes inventory e-commerce entities), payment_intermediary (banks, wallets and other regulated payment or banking entities). An empty list means the chunk is general (procedure, definitions, rights that apply to everyone, information pages). The chunk is found by source, section and a clause number inside it (null: the whole section). Because the author is also an AI, agreement with these labels is a consistency check, not proof of legal correctness. A human reviewer should relabel before the numbers are trusted.
